Glance 2026.09.29 adds optional FFmpeg playback and refines preview controls and notifications.

- Preview uncommon audio and video formats with an optional FFmpeg software decoder. Unsupported system playback falls back automatically, and a setting lets you prefer software decoding.
- Manage FFmpeg and FFprobe from the add-ons page. Advanced media information registers its own FFprobe dependency, and available PATH installations can be reused.
- Click a video to pause or resume. Pausing briefly shows a white pause symbol on a translucent black background. Loop playback is enabled by default.
- Configure adaptive-sizing pauses for always-shown windows and gallery mode together under Window settings.
- Preview notices stack in arrival order and move smoothly as older messages disappear; progress updates remain attached to their own messages.
- Fullscreen double-click detection uses half the system double-click interval.
- Portable installations request Core administrator access automatically. The settings indicator reports the connected Core's actual permissions, and cancelled elevation can be retried from settings.
- Correct software playback seeking, buffering and timing, improve media cleanup, and prevent middle-click gallery switching from toggling playback.
